lead: Jagdeep Dhankhar is a widely followed Indian lawyer, born on 18 May 1951 in Jhunjhunu district.
As of 2026, he is 75 years old, and his birth date places him under the Taurus sign.
He has held the office of Member of the Rajasthan Legislative Assembly and Member of the 9th Lok Sabha.

sections.heading: Jagdeep Dhankhar — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists lawyer as his main occupation.

He has held the following offices: Member of the Rajasthan Legislative Assembly, Member of the 9th Lok Sabha (1989–1991), Governor of West Bengal (2019–2022) and Vice President of India (2022–2025). He is affiliated with Janata Dal.
